title: Non-invasive glucose measurements with optoacoustic and optothermal spectroscopy (OA/OT-S) in the mid-infrared
summary: People with Type 2 Diabetes mellitus have to continuously monitor their blood sugar levels. Until now, blood glucose levels could not be measured without invasive methods. In this study, the principle of two new non-invasive methods will be tested on healthy people to see whether they are suitable for measuring blood glucose levels.

interventions.name: blood glucose measurement with OA-S and OT-S in 10 healthy participants and comparison with measurements from continuous glucose patch (e.g. FreeStyle Libre or similar): empty stomach/before glucose intake, 30 min after glucose intake (75 g), 60 min after glucose intake

control to Arm 2: blood glucose measurement with OA-S and OT-S in 10 healthy participants and comparison with measurements from continuous glucose patch (e.g. FreeStyle Libre or similar): empty stomach/before water intake, 30 min after water intake, 60 min after water intake

blood glucose measurement with OA-S and OT-S in 36 healthy participants and comparison with measurements capillary blood test every 5 min (from 20 min before glucose intake until 2h 20 min after glucose intake (75 g))

control to Arm 3: blood glucose measurement with OA-S and OT-S in 36 healthy participants and comparison with measurements capillary blood test every 5 min (from 20 min before water intake until 2h 20 min after water intake)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
healthy persons
all genders, ethnicities, skin colors
Exclusion criteria:
- Refusal of the examination/consent
- Pregnancy or breastfeeding
- Documented or suspected metabolic or cardiovascular diseases
- Documented or suspected light allergy, light intolerance, contact dermatitis or particularly sensitive skin
- Age under 22 or over 60 years
- Open or infected skin wounds
- Active systemic infection
- Documented known skin diseases
